plain: Kindness and a wish to do good for others

webster.text: The disposition to do good; good will; kindness; charitableness; the love of mankind, accompanied with a desire to promote their happiness.

more.text: An act of kindness; good done; charity given.
A species of contribution or tax illegally exacted by arbitrary kings of England.

example.quote: to countenance and inculcate the principles of humanity and general benevolence, public and private charity, industry and frugality, honesty and punctuality in their dealings;
